KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. mitoto

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.

7. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. zito

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

9. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Lishe Bora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma: Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
